The Cadillac CUE infotainment system with embedded navigation guides your route, while Apple CarPlay keeps your smartphone's functions within reach. SiriusXM satellite radio reaches across the country to bring entertainment wherever you travel. The 16-speaker audio system delivers quality sound whether you're listening to music or taking calls through the steering wheel controls.  Safety and comfort extend to all passengers. Second and third-row occupants enjoy heated seats and their own climate controls, while the rear audio controls allow them to adjust entertainment options. The backup camera assists with parking and maneuvering in tight spaces, and OnStar Protection provides emergency communication services for added peace of mind.  The Escalade's exterior presents a polished appearance with its white Crystal Tricoat paint, complemented by 20-inch chrome-plated aluminum wheels and body-color bumpers. Heated and power-adjustable door mirrors with turn signal indicators combine practical features with the luxury SUV aesthetic. description: This 2023 Toyota Venza Limited represents a refined choice for buyers seeking a reliable crossover with practical comfort and efficient performance.  - Star Gaze Fixed Panoramic Roof with frosted glass and power sunshade - All-Wheel Drive with 2.5L 4-Cylinder DOHC 16V engine - 40 city / 37 highway MPG with CVT transmission - Navigation System and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto connectivity - SiriusXM AM/FM radio with steering wheel-mounted audio controls - Automatic temperature control with front dual-zone air conditioning - Safety Connect emergency communication system (1-year trial included) - Power driver seat with telescoping and tilt steering wheel - Leather steering wheel and shift knob - Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering - Auto high-beam headlights with fully automatic operation - Electronic Stability Control and traction control - Dual front impact airbags, side impact airbags, and overhead airbag - Split folding rear seat with rear seat center armrest - Body-color bumpers and alloy wheels  The Venza Limited delivers everyday practicality without compromise. The panoramic roof creates an open, airy cabin that enhances the driving experience, while the available all-wheel-drive system provides confident traction in diverse weather conditions. With 40 MPG in city driving and 37 on the highway, this crossover balances efficiency with capability, making it suited for both daily commutes and longer journeys.  Inside, the cabin reflects thoughtful design. The dual-zone automatic climate control ensures passenger comfort, while the leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob add a touch of refinement. Navigation integration combined with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keeps you oriented and in touch with your digital world. The power liftgate and split-folding rear seat provide flexible cargo management for shopping trips or weekend adventures.  Safety is prioritized throughout. The comprehensive airbag system, including knee and overhead protection, works alongside electronic stability control and traction management. The low tire pressure warning system helps maintain optimal vehicle performance. Toyota's Safety Connect emergency communication system comes with a one-year trial, offering added peace of mind during unexpected situations.  The driving experience is supported by four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering, which adapts responsive feedback to various driving speeds. Auto high-beam headlights adjust to road conditions automatically, improving visibility and reducing driver fatigue. The electronic parking brake and brake assist technologies make everyday driving more convenient and controlled.  This Venza Limited is ready for your next chapter. The 3.6L V6 engine paired with the 9-speed automatic transmission provides smooth acceleration and reliable performance for both commuting and longer journeys.  Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully appointed cabin designed for comfort and convenience. The Caprice leatherette bucket seats offer supportive seating, while heated front seats and a heated steering wheel add warmth during cooler months. The Touring Suspension ensures a composed ride quality, and the automatic temperature control system with front dual zone capability lets passengers customize their comfort independently.  The Uconnect 5 system with its 10.1-inch touchscreen display serves as your command center, offering seamless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility. SiriusXM radio keeps you entertained with premium content, while steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your attention on the road. The ParkView rear back-up camera and parking assistance features make maneuvering easier in tight spaces.  Safety is integrated throughout this Pacifica, with electronic stability control, traction control, ABS braking, and a comprehensive airbag system providing multiple layers of protection. The four-wheel independent suspension contributes to both stability and ride comfort, while rain-sensing wipers and fully automatic headlights enhance visibility in various weather conditions.
